training.loss: history_gated_group_v1: gate*relu(m-(lc-l0)) + contrast*[relu(m-(lc-ls))+relu(m-(lc-li))] + anchor*[smooth_l1(ls,l0)+smooth_l1(li,l0)] + l2*sum(A^2+B^2), ce=0, l0 frozen ctx=None detached

gates.b0_bitwise_parity: ctx=None forward must equal frozen baseline exactly (adapter fully bypassed)
gates.note: heldout salt odyssey_margin_v1 keeps the exact split of causalcache_odyssey_margin_v1; b0 scores are frozen-model scores by construction
gates.cadence: score heldout contrasts per step checkpoint (--checkpoint-every-steps 25)

data.prompt_format: frozen mixed-fidelity builder; identical to AndroidWorld closed-loop
